newsitem.title: POLAND: Animex seeks 20 pct of Polish meat mkt.
newsitem.headline: Animex seeks 20 pct of Polish meat mkt.

text.p: Polish meat firm Animex seeks a 20-percent share of Poland's meat and poultry market, the firm's president told daily Parkiet in its Thursday edition.
"Our strategic goal is to gain a 20-percent market share," Witold Pereta was quoted as saying without giving a target date or the firm's current market share.
In December the firm said it had sought 15 percent of the Polish market.

Pereta also said the firm planned to list at least five subsidiaries by the end of the nineties. Among them Ekrodob was due this year, Animex Wielkopolska next year, then possibly the Mazury plant in the town of Elk and Szczecin-based Agryf.
Pereta said the firm's planned issue of 10 million shares would be directed largely to investors in Japan, Britain and the United States.
